svg.text: Expected truth: CDC's deposited haplotype calls for the benchmark specimens
153 of 203 specimens appear in CDC's haplotype data sheet · one column per named haplotype, grouped by locus
filled box = haplotype detected · white = locus called but this haplotype absent · grey = no call at this locus

Layout after Fig. 3 of Barratt et al. 2019 (doi:10.1017/S0031182019000581). Calls from 2022-10-24Joel_haplotype_sheet.txt, deposited in the Eukaryotpying-Python repo as example input — real data, but not a published results set.
Unlike that figure, grey here means only that no haplotype was called at the locus — the sheet does not distinguish assay failure from a product that missed the calling threshold.
